notes.title: UPDATE: Caching histograms for Cribbage Solitaire
notes.content: Today's update changes the histograms for Cribbage Solitaire to be included with the game instead of being downloaded from our servers.

notes.title: UPDATE: Fix for blurry cards in Proletariat's Patience
notes.content: Today's update fixes an issue with blurry cards in Proletariat's Patience when using low-quality textures.

notes.title: UPDATE: Fixing a Mac-specific hang when starting the game
notes.content:
This update fixes a Mac-specific hang when starting the game.

It also adds some black bars when zoom is enabled on non-16:9 displays.

notes.title: UPDATE: Crash fix
notes.content: Today's update fixes a crash when starting the game with zoom mode enabled.

notes.title: UPDATE: Stack movement and screen zoom
notes.content:
Today's update adds two new features that can be turned on in the in-game options menu:

[list]
[*] An auto-mover for Fortune's Foundation that moves entire stacks of cards to follow the first.
[*] An experimental zoom feature that makes some of the smaller games fill up more of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Zachtronics combined tarot with solitaire, and it's my new daily jam
notes.content: Since I drifted away from Wordle and Knotwords earlier this year I've been looking for a new game to play in short sessions every morning or evening: Just a little something to puzzle over during coffee and again to unwind with at the end of the day. I wouldn't have expected to find what I was looking for in a solitaire game, but Zachtronics proved me wrong... Read more.

notes.title: UPDATE: Achievements and click-click dragging
notes.content: Today's update adds some achievements and a setting that, when turned on, makes it so that you can drag cards without having to hold the mouse button.

notes.title: UPDATE: Assorted bug fixes
notes.content:
Today's update includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] [Sigmar's Garden] Locked marbles are back to being faded, although a little less so than in Opus Magnum.
[*] [Sawayama Solitaire] Made the auto-mover more conservative, so that it never causes you to lose a game.
[*] [Kabufuda Solitaire] Fixed a bug where opening the instructions while dealing would cause cards to disappear.
[*] [General] Fixed the dealing sound effects for all of the games to be interruptible and non-stacking.
[*] [General] Fixed a crash when failing to find a valid window resolution.
[/list]

notes.title: The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection is out now
notes.content:
They will be missed and this is technically now actually their last game, with the The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection officially out now with Linux support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/09/the-zachtronics-solitaire-collection-is-out-now

notes.title: UPDATE: Fix for blurry mouse cursors
notes.content: This update fixes a bug where the mouse cursors in Sawayama Solitaire and Cluj Solitaire were blurry when using low-resolution textures.

notes.title: Zachtronics are collecting all their solitaire games together in September
notes.content:
Former indie puzzle specialists Zachtronics are releasing another game despite having closed their doors earlier this year. It’s a collection of their many minigame interpretations of the classic single-player card game, solitaire. The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection releases on Steam on September 6th, and adds a new version themed around tarot decks. Each version of the card game has been updated with 4K graphics. Have a sneaky peek at the trailer below.

Read more

notes.title: The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection releases September 6
notes.content:
Okay so perhaps Last Call BBS being their actual final game was a sweet little lie from Zachtronics. Well, sort of, as The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection is technically not exactly a new game.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/08/the-zachtronics-solitaire-collection-releases-september-6

notes.title: The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection will be out next week
notes.content: Earlier this year, Zachtronics, the indie studio dedicated to making puzzle games that teach you programming languages or entire new ways of thinking, announced it was making its final new game. That game was Last Call BBS, an anthology that includes an excellent model-robot-assembly simulator and another of the Solitaire variants that have become the studio's hallmark. Although Zachtronics isn't backing down on the "no more new games" part of the deal, the studio always planned to follow Last Call BBS with a compilation of all its Solitaire variants as a kind of epilogue. It's now announced The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection will be released on Steam next week... Read more.
